categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in network visualization and intelligent solutions, information security protection solutions, and big data solutions. Its business includes design, implementation, software and hardware development, product sales, and technical services. Key products include intelligent collection management systems, intelligent application systems, internet information security management systems, and abnormal traffic monitoring and protection systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies such as large-scale high-speed DPI (Deep Packet Inspection) technology, PB-level big data processing platforms, large-scale network user perception and service quality analysis, large-scale network abnormal traffic and content detection, and virtualization-based cloud security management. It employs FPGA chip design, ATCA and CLOS hardware architectures, and integrates AI, machine learning, and big data analytics. Production involves assembling hardware products, programming chips, and outsourcing PCB welding.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The main customers are telecommunications operators, including the three major Chinese telecom operators, with a strong focus on China Mobile. The company also serves government and enterprise sectors. Its products are widely deployed in backbone, interconnection, provincial networks, and IDC export points, supporting large-scale network environments.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with business covering nationwide regions including Northeast, North China, East China, South China, Central China, Northwest, and Southwest. It has subsidiaries in Beijing, Shanghai, and Hefei.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the network technology supply chain, focusing on software and hardware development, system integration, and providing network visualization, security, and big data solutions. It procures electronic components and outsourced PCB assembly from suppliers but performs core technology development and final product assembly internally.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes technology and model innovation driven by AI and big data, focusing on large network security, data elements, intelligent applications, and domestic substitution. R&D priorities include upgrading DPI technology with domestic chips, developing intelligent traffic filtering and distributed edge computing, enhancing big data platforms, and advancing AI-powered deep synthesis detection for security. The company maintains strong collaborations with universities and research institutes to bolster innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of network visualization, information security, and big data solutions, combined with technical services including data analysis and operation and maintenance support. Sales are mainly conducted via direct sales through bidding, single-source procurement, and business negotiations, with a significant portion from long-term contracts with telecom operators.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading domestic position in network visualization and DPI technology, competing in the first tier within China. It has a strong market share in telecom operator contracts, notably securing over 50% of China Mobile's internet DPI centralized procurement. Its products outperform foreign competitors in functionality, performance, and cost-effectiveness, enabling domestic substitution.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 520 million, a 15.85% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 62.9 million, up 32.43%. The company has total assets of around RMB 1.3 billion and net assets of RMB 1.04 billion, with a steady growth trajectory supported by increased R&D investment (19.26% of revenue) and improved cash flow from operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its deep technical expertise and proprietary core technologies in DPI, big data, and AI integration, offering high-performance, scalable, and intelligent network visualization and security solutions. Its products provide comprehensive traffic identification, real-time analysis, and security protection tailored to large-scale telecom networks, with superior cost-effectiveness and domestic chip integration, supporting national strategies like digital China and new infrastructure development.
